# strip (SMC17/strip)

> Evidence-bearing aerospace computation and 6-DOF flight simulation substrate in Zig (WGS84, US76 atmosphere, fixed-wing/multirotor, FMI 3.0, MAVLink, HLA/DIS).

- Companion Unified Substrate: https://github.com/SMC17/zinging
